about.headline: Using data to uncover insights and support better decisions.
paragraphs: I am an aspiring Data Analyst passionate about using data to uncover insights and support informed decision-making. My toolkit is built around Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI and Machine Learning, with a focus on solving real-world analytical problems.

I have built practical projects in data analytics and machine learning, including a Movie Recommendation System, SQL analytics projects and interactive dashboards. Through them I have gained hands-on experience in data preprocessing, visualization, statistical analysis and predictive modelling.
I am currently seeking opportunities in Data Analytics, Business Analytics and Data Science where I can apply these skills, contribute to impactful projects and keep growing as a data professional.
